title: Deleted something by mistake? Undo it in 1 second ↩️ #Shorts
description:
Deleted your text or made a mistake? Hold Ctrl and press Z, and your last action is undone instantly.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + Z
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Z

Press it again to undo more steps. Changed your mind? Redo with Ctrl + Y (Mac: Cmd + Shift + Z).

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔

#techtips #lifehacks #productivity #shorts #undo #shortcuts
